What's behind Zenith cutting Le Locle jobs in half? The LVMH watch brand confirmed mass-layoff talks for about 100 of 196 jobs, citing the strong franc and tariffs; worker talks open 26 October. This week also: Richemont and Signet weigh capital in the De Beers bid, Botswana nears a quarter of De Beers, a flawless Christie's round missed its estimate, and Zijin completes control of Chifeng Gold as its board resigns.
